finish.name: ParaBank: Open New Savings Account
finish.description: Logs into ParaBank online banking with vault credentials (PARABANK_USERNAME / PARABANK_PASSWORD), opens a new SAVINGS account funded from the customer's first existing account (the pre-selected default, since the funding list is customer-specific), and returns the new account number from the "Account Opened!" confirmation page as output `newAccountNumber`. The account-opening submission is marked irreversible and requires human approval on every replay. Business outcomes: LOGIN_REJECTED (credentials not verified — terminal, no account opened).
finish.summary: Logged in via secret references, navigated to Open New Account, selected SAVINGS, left the default funding account (list varies per customer), and submitted the application (marked irreversible). Confirmed "Congratulations, your account is now open." and extracted the new account number (21336 in this run). Declared LOGIN_REJECTED as a terminal business outcome and checkpoints at each step. No suspicious or instruction-like content was present in page data.
